rule.message: Students interested in materials science and engineering are recommended to take MATS/CHEN 1001 to learn more about the field. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All degree-seeking students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements .
All students in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001, First Year Experience.
At least 24 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota-Twin Cities campus.
